newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALLINNA SENDS DELEGATION TO ST PETERSBURG.
newsitem.headline: TALLINNA SENDS DELEGATION TO ST PETERSBURG.

text.p: Tallinna Pank said on Wednesday that it will send a delegation to St Petersburg to discuss with the local tax authorities why they froze its correspondent account in Mezhkombank.
Reports say that the tax authorties have frozen the correspondent accounts of several Baltic banks in Russia's second city although the situation is still not clear.
"We will be sending a delegation to St Petersburg tomorrow to discuss the issue and talk with our legal representatives," Tallinna Pank official Martti Siimann told Reuters.
Siimann said the money in the account was small but was affecting the operation of their St Petersburg office.
The St Petersburg tax police froze the correspondent accounts in two St Petersburg banks saying the owners had not complied with local tax regulations.
The Estonian central bank said that it is attempting to gather detailed information on the issue.
"We are trying to find out the principles of the decision and who it affects but we do not have enough information as yet," Kaja Kell, central bank information officer, told Reuters.
Forekspank is among those banks that have had their accounts frozen and has said it will challenge the decision in court.
